name: github-workflow-run
description: Read the newest FINISHED run of one GitHub Actions workflow on one branch and say whether it passed. It sends GitHub no filter: it reads the workflow's 30 newest runs on every branch and itself chooses the newest finished run on BRANCH that a pull request did not trigger (GitHub's branch and status filters were measured answering from a list nine days stale). If none of the 30 is one, the state is none. OUTPUT: {provider, repo, workflow, branch, state, run: {id, number, event, conclusion, head_sha, branch, url, title, created_at, finished_at}}. state is failing (failure, timed_out, startup_failure), passing (success), other (cancelled, skipped, neutral and anything newer) or none (no finished run on that branch; `run` is absent). OPS ALERT: with ALERT true (the default) a failing run raises or bumps ONE rolling ops alert per repo/workflow/branch (source github-actions, severity hint from SEVERITY, default high) and a passing run resolves it; other leaves it alone. The alert records the state; it does not tell anyone — put a compose node after this one to decide when to notify (for example once per run). A run still in progress is never read as finished. CREDENTIALS: none for a public repository (GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated requests an hour per address, so poll no more often than every few minutes); for a private repository or a higher limit set AUTH_HEADER to a vault:// reference. A non-2xx answer fails the node with the status only. GRANTS: installs with api.github.com and GET.

WORKFLOW.description: The workflow's file name (quality.yml) or its numeric id.

ALERT.description: Raise and resolve the rolling ops alert.

SEVERITY.description: Severity hint for the ops alert when a run fails.

AUTH_HEADER.description: Optional. 'Bearer vault://<path>' for a private repository or a higher rate limit. Grant the path with update_module_secrets.

setup_instructions.title: Name the workflow
setup_instructions.detail: Set REPO and WORKFLOW (and BRANCH if it is not main).

setup_instructions.title: Decide who is told
setup_instructions.detail: This node only records the state as an ops alert. To be notified once per failed run, follow it with a compose node that remembers the last run it reported, and a notify-* adapter (docs/notification-contract.md).

setup_instructions.title: Schedule it
setup_instructions.detail: Every 5 to 15 minutes is enough; unauthenticated requests are limited to 60 an hour per address.
